soundness_flags.label: thm:finite-two-source-expansion
soundness_flags.one_line: Squaring the stated QTE error also produces -2⟨D_post, Σ_j(ŵ_j-w_j)Q_j⟩, generically O_P(n_ell^{-1/2}m_ell^{-1/4}), which is absent and larger than the claimed remainder.

soundness_flags.label: thm:three-phase-expansion
soundness_flags.one_line: The omitted pre-weight/post-quantile cross term survives under rho_ell→kappa, so the displayed intermediate limit cannot be only Psi_t(d,Z)+A_t(V_h)/kappa.

soundness_flags.label: thm:j2s2-certification
soundness_flags.one_line: The worked instance uses post support {0,2} while the maintained common support has arbitrary length D; it must set D≥2 (preferably D=2) to be a legal member of M.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:oracle-common-cutoff and oeq:feasible-certified-calibration
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The oracle criterion optimizes only one deterministic cutoff conditional on eta, not arbitrary randomized or observation-dependent radii.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The cutoff is least only within C_eta; the feasible target is conditional-cutoff attainment, not global minimax optimality over all radius rules.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Applied Econometrics 35(5), version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published summary identifies counterfactuals by matching treated pre-intervention quantile residuals to a convex combination of potential-control residuals orthogonal to observable common factors.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher record, pp. 1105-1117, abstract; formula text access-controlled
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The version of record describes replication of a treated quantile function by a weighted average of control quantile functions and applicability to arbitrary distribution types; its Proposition 5 formula could not be inspected in this version.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv manuscript, March 2026 revision; corroboration only, not substituted for the cited version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The manuscript's Proposition 5 is a discrete finite-support, fixed-optimal-weight goodness-of-fit limit with squared-Wasserstein normalization of root-n order; it is not used to assert a version-of-record formula match.
The paper treats one-preperiod DSC with continuous empirical quantiles, a dilution condition, and a conditional Gaussian approximation for mixture weights.
Theorem 2 assumes the infeasible post-period optimum is interior and gives a rate for DSC weights involving fit terms and M^{-1/4}J.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 115(529), version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article constructs simultaneous confidence bands for discrete or mixed-outcome quantile and quantile-effect functions by transforming simultaneous distribution-function bands.
